summary: Wave C3 PT-PT localization tested. Backend arranca limpo (no import/syntax errors after diy.py translation and 'Bonjour'->'Olá' substitutions across 13 files). All 9 backend endpoints tested pass: auth/login (admin + PT admin), auth/me returns country=PT/language=pt for PT admin, /api/estimation/catalog returns lots with PT-PT labels, /api/diy/tasks and /api/diy/guide/plafond_placo return content in PT-PT with no French words. Frontend: NO JS errors (0 pageerrors) on all target pages, all pages render successfully. However, significant residual French strings still leak in several UI components — the biggest offender is PlanTakeoff.jsx (hero section at /plan is entirely in French despite the '500+ substituições' claim), and Nav.jsx which shows 'Administrateur' on every authenticated page.

ui_bugs.issue: Role label 'Administrateur' shown globally in top-right nav on every authenticated page (should be 'Administrador' PT-PT)

Entire hero/landing section still in French: 'Importez votre plan. Mesurez automatiquement. Chiffrez.', 'PDF architecte, plan scanné, photo smartphone : ConstruPilot calibre l'échelle...', 'Guide : du plan au devis', 'Importer mon plan', 'Corriger la perspective (photo smartphone inclinée)', 'Comparer 2 plans (avant / après)', 'Formats variés', 'Multi-étages'. The 500+ substitutions did not cover this hero block.
French strings remain: 'Mode démo — tout débloquer', tabs 'Bibliothèque', 'Ouvrages composés', 'Publicité', 'Campagnes e-mail', column header 'Unité'

issues: Route paths themselves remain French: /plan, /factures, /factures-electroniques, /rendu-ia, /fonctionnalites. The review requested paths like /plans, /invoices, /e-invoicing, /features, /render-studio which do not exist and return 404. Consider adding PT aliases (e.g., /planta, /faturas, /faturacao-eletronica, /render-ia, /funcionalidades) — /funcionalidades exists but others do not.

critical_code_review_comments: Backend imports and syntax are clean after LLM translation of engines/diy.py — no reload failures.
PT admin (info@construpilot.pt) correctly resolves country=PT and language=pt in /api/auth/me.
The scope of PlanTakeoff.jsx substitutions seems to have missed the top hero section — the largest visible French block on any authenticated page.
Nav.jsx role labels are hardcoded and untranslated — single-source fix will remove French across every page.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully PT-PT for auth/catalog/diy — no need to retest unless new engine files change. Frontend needs to re-verify Nav.jsx, PlanTakeoff.jsx hero, Entreprise.jsx, Admin.jsx tabs+demo banner, Features.jsx, Account.jsx after fixes. Use FR regex from test_c3_wave.py concept and route paths: /entreprise, /admin, /factures-electroniques, /plan (NOT /plans), /factures, /situations, /rendu-ia, /funcionalidades, /compte.
rca of the issue: The ~1137 FR->PT-PT substitutions were driven by a glossary + manual passes but did not cover: (1) Nav.jsx role label 'Administrateur'; (2) the PlanTakeoff.jsx marketing hero which likely lives in a distinct component or is a longer literal that was skipped; (3) Entreprise.jsx button labels ('Identité pro', 'Boîte e-mail', 'Gérer'); (4) Admin.jsx demo-mode banner and 6 tab labels; (5) Features.jsx and Account.jsx a handful of short verbs. No JS errors introduced; issue is purely missed literals, easy to fix by targeted replacements in the listed files.
